name: 1 MB question payload token flooding
description: Client sends 1 megabyte question payload designed to exhaust server memory or context.
expected_defence: RequestSizeLimitMiddleware rejects with HTTP 413 Content Too Large without consuming LLM cycles.

name: Malformed JSON body to chat endpoint
description: Client sends truncated or invalid JSON string.
expected_defence: FastAPI exception handler returns typed ErrorEnvelope with HTTP 422 with zero stack trace.

name: Missing or invalid API authorization key
description: Request made without Authorization header or with bogus token.
expected_defence: Auth dependency rejects with HTTP 401 and typed ErrorEnvelope.

name: Queue starvation / cross-tenant flooding
description: Tenant A submits 25 requests simultaneously; Tenant B submits 1 legitimate request.
expected_defence: BoundedLlmQueue sheds excess load with HTTP 429 Retry-After, preserving capacity for Tenant B.

name: Internal error triggering stack trace or secret leak
description: Client forces an unhandled internal exception to test for leaked tracebacks or credentials.
expected_defence: Global exception handler catches exception, returns generic error envelope with request_id and ZERO stack trace.

name: Fault injection header sent when disabled
description: Client sends X-Fault-Inject: oom when ALLOW_FAULT_INJECTION=False.
expected_defence: Header is ignored; server executes normal pipeline without injecting artificial fault.
